_comment: The seed-9 gi=8 T4 board as the user actually left it -- both Conservatories, the second
Overgrowth, and a FULL 49-card opponent library rather than the trimmed 12 of fixture 1. It is
the same defect at the size that matters: 49 exiles need 49 colourless pips, which the loop can
only bank one per iteration, so FlickerGoOffCount's {C} term (MTG_EDF_GOFF_C_ITERS) is what
carries it -- sizing by mana alone asks for 33 iterations, banks the mana, comes up 16 pips
short, and SpendSurplusOnExile (all-or-nothing) then fires zero times.
The user's float of {G:86} is deliberately NOT staged: the scenario harness cannot, and the
point is that the board funds the finish on its own. Passing without it is the stronger claim.
